CONSENT_MODAL.TITLE: Monitoring Consent Notice
CONSENT_MODAL.DESCRIPTION: This environment collects interaction data on the programming learning process, data collection only occurs after triggering the "Monitor Performance" button and stops after clicking the "Stop Monitoring and Download Log" button.
CONSENT_MODAL.COLLECTED_DATA_1: Start and end date and time of the activity.
CONSENT_MODAL.COLLECTED_DATA_3: Code version history for each compilation attempt.
CONSENT_MODAL.USAGE_1: The data is stored locally in your browser and exported in TXT format at the end of the monitoring.
CONSENT_MODAL.USAGE_2: Which can be used for analysis and performance improvement.
CONSENT_MODAL.RIGHTS_2: You can stop collection at any time by clicking 'Stop Monitoring', without penalties.
CONSENT_MODAL.CHECKBOX: I understand the information above and consent to the monitoring of my activity.

VALIDATION.VARIABLE_NAME_EMPTY: There is a variable without a name. Please fill in the variable name before running.
VALIDATION.VARIABLE_NAME_INVALID: The variable name "{{name}}" cannot contain spaces. Please fix it before running.
VALIDATION.VARIABLE_VALUE_EMPTY: The variable "{{name}}" has no initial value. Please provide a value before running.
VALIDATION.VARIABLE_NOT_IN_SCOPE: The variable "{{name}}" used in a command does not exist or is declared after this command. Check the block order or reselect the variable.
VALIDATION.OPERATOR_TARGET_EMPTY: There is an Assignment/Math block without a target variable selected.
VALIDATION.OPERATOR_EXPRESSION_INCOMPLETE: The assignment for "{{name}}" has an incomplete expression. Please fill in all terms before running.
VALIDATION.WRITER_INCOMPLETE: There is an incomplete Write command. Select the type and content before running.
VALIDATION.CONDITIONAL_INCOMPLETE: There is an If…Then structure with an incomplete condition. Check the blocks before running.
VALIDATION.FOR_INCOMPLETE: There is a Repeat_For loop with incomplete fields. Fill in variable, start, end, and step before running.
VALIDATION.FOR_INVALID_STEP: In the Repeat_For loop for variable "{{name}}", the step value must be a number greater than zero.
VALIDATION.FOR_INVALID_DIRECTION: In the Repeat_For loop for variable "{{name}}", the step direction ({{direction}}) is incompatible with start ({{start}}) and end ({{finish}}) values.

EXECUTION_ERROR.INTERNAL_SYNTAX: Could not run the program because there is a block with an incomplete expression or command. Please review the filled fields.
EXECUTION_ERROR.INFINITE_LOOP: Execution stopped because the program exceeded the instruction limit (possible infinite loop). Check the loop bounds and step.
EXECUTION_ERROR.GENERIC: Error running the program. Verify that all variables and expressions are filled in correctly.
